id: Monty Python and the Holy Grail (1975)
title: Monty Python and the Holy Grail
about: King Arthur and his knights ride coconuts across Britain hunting the Grail, past killer rabbits, French taunters and a bridge with three questions.
cue: Serve the rabbit pie when the knights charge the Rabbit of Caerbannog.
faces: Patsy bangs two coconut halves together. Crisp coconut-crumbed prawns with lime mayo.
The bridgekeeper's unladen swallow. Honey and soy chicken wings with sesame.
The rabbit that sees off three knights. Slow-braised rabbit under a golden pastry lid.
And the people did feast upon the lambs. Slow-roast lamb shoulder with garlic and rosemary.
Your father smelt of elderberries. Apples and dark berries under an oat crumble.
The Knights Who Say Ni want a shrubbery. Mint and cucumber soda over plenty of ice.
When the bell rings: Serve the rabbit pie when the knights charge the Rabbit of Caerbannog.
"On second thought, let's not go to Camelot. It is a silly place."
Coin of the realm only. Bill No. 3, AD 932. Images: TMDB

    To beginPatsy's coconut prawnsPatsy bangs two coconut halves together. Crisp coconut-crumbed prawns with lime mayo.How to make it500g raw king prawns, peeled with tails on50g plain flour2 eggs60g desiccated coconut60g panko breadcrumbs500ml vegetable oil, for frying4 tbsp whole-egg mayonnaise1 limeDust the prawns in seasoned flour, dip in beaten egg, then press into the coconut mixed with panko.Fry in hot oil in batches until golden, about 2 minutes.Stir lime zest and juice into the mayo.Serve the prawns hot with the lime mayo.Unladen swallow sticky wingsThe bridgekeeper's unladen swallow. Honey and soy chicken wings with sesame.How to make it1kg chicken wings, tips removed3 tbsp honey3 tbsp soy sauce2 garlic cloves, crushed1 tbsp grated ginger1 tbsp sesame seeds2 spring onions, slicedToss the wings with the honey, soy, garlic and ginger.Spread on a lined tray and bake at 200°C, turning once, until sticky and dark.Scatter with sesame seeds and spring onions to serve.Peasant's bread and drippingHelp, help, I'm being repressed!How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.From the hearthRabbit of Caerbannog pieThe rabbit that sees off three knights. Slow-braised rabbit under a golden pastry lid.How to make it1.2kg rabbit pieces2 tbsp plain flour2 tbsp olive oil150g smoky bacon, diced2 carrots, diced1 brown onion, diced250ml cloudy apple juice250ml chicken stock1 tbsp wholegrain mustard3 thyme sprigs1 sheet puff pastry1 egg, beatenToss the rabbit in seasoned flour and brown in the oil, then set aside.Fry the bacon, carrot and onion until soft.Return the rabbit with the apple juice, stock, mustard and thyme and simmer covered until tender.Pull the meat from the bones and tip the filling into a pie dish.Top with pastry, brush with egg and bake at 200°C until puffed and golden.Feast-upon-the-lambs roast shoulderAnd the people did feast upon the lambs. Slow-roast lamb shoulder with garlic and rosemary.How to make it2kg bone-in lamb shoulder6 garlic cloves, sliced4 rosemary sprigs2 tbsp olive oil1kg potatoes, in chunks2 brown onions, in wedges250ml chicken stock3 tbsp mint jellyStab the lamb all over and push in the garlic and rosemary, then rub with oil and salt.Sit the lamb on the potatoes and onions, pour in the stock, cover and roast at 160°C.Uncover and roast at 200°C until the skin is crisp and the potatoes are golden.Rest, then pull the meat from the bone and serve with mint jelly.Sweet thingsSmelt-of-elderberries apple crumbleYour father smelt of elderberries. Apples and dark berries under an oat crumble.How to make it5 Granny Smith apples, peeled and sliced150g frozen blackberries3 tbsp elderflower cordial60g brown sugar150g plain flour60g rolled oats100g cold butter, cubed80g caster sugar500ml vanilla custardToss the apples and berries with the cordial and brown sugar in a baking dish.Rub the butter into the flour, oats and caster sugar until it clumps.Scatter over the fruit and bake at 180°C until golden and bubbling.Serve warm with the custard.Mugs and cupsA shrubbery coolerThe Knights Who Say Ni want a shrubbery. Mint and cucumber soda over plenty of ice.How to make it1 cup mint leaves100g caster sugar100ml water1 Lebanese cucumber, thinly sliced2 limes750ml soda water2 cups ice cubesHeat the sugar and water until dissolved, add half the mint and cool.Fill 4 glasses with ice, cucumber, the rest of the mint and a squeeze of lime.Add the strained syrup and top with soda.Blue lemonade, or yellowGalahad never could decide.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.
